caption: The drawing depicts a single woven basket placed against a plain, light beige background. The basket is predominantly brown with slight variations in shade to represent the texture and pattern of the weaving. The main body of the basket is wide at the base and tapers toward the top, where the opening is round and slightly flared. The weaving is detailed, with horizontal and vertical interlaces visible throughout the basket. Around the top portion of the basket is a band with twisted rope-like detailing, from which three elongated, spindle-shaped decorative elements hang down, each also brown and constructed to match the basket’s material. The composition centers the basket, and there are no additional elements or objects present in the drawing. In the lower right corner, the artist’s signature, "Vincent P. Hotel," along with the number "3904 - Del," is visible.
title: Traveling Basket
